entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents (in future), girl children, nonlesbian women

entries.land_description: land adjoining several hundred wild, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity in some buildings, camping space, woods, bio-dynamic garden
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, workshop participants, workshop guides, internships-apprentices, staff, private retreatants, artists in residence, all wild women, whatever stage or age on the feminist journey
entries.notes: From Spring to Fall our intensive residential courses and retreats for women expand the heart, challenge thinking, and offer practical tools and experience. creating new names as we go. women living and workin' the land.

entries.land_description: housing/permanent structures, electricity, well water, outhouse, camping space, woods
entries.welcomed_groups: girl children (boys by invitation only!), nonlesbian women, dogs
entries.notes: We are a small family of 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 1 dog, 4 cats, 1 horse (soon to be more). We've cleared trails for hiking, picnics, camping, etc. Our 30 acres is surrounded by 100's of acres of unused, undeveloped land at present. We currently have no housing for other lesbian visitors but we welcome campers. Must be able to hike to campsite carry all needs in and out! Camping available near road for differently abled lesbians. We do not smoke, drink, use drugs. women living and workin' on the land.

entries.land_description: almost all uphill., both ponds are fine for swimming
entries.notes: This is additional info to our listing in VI,2. We can offer retreat and healing space mostly in the form of primitive camping - $2 to $5 a day if you can. Our accessibility is unfortunately poor (143 acres almost all uphill.) We'll probably have a visitor' kitchen so please bring your own food, the sauna is in progress. Work is welcomed. Chemicals are discouraged.

entries.land_description: with cows (beef and milk), chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden, house, barn, electricity, woods, farmland, pasture
entries.notes: (Between Harrisburg and Gettysburg.) I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres with cows (beef and milk), chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden. I am not a separatist and cannot accomodate flag-waving, breast-baring sisters. Visits (limited to 2-3 days) require work exchange. No drugs, cigarettes, pets, guns. Visitors are expected to bring own food, etc. I prefer that you telephone so that we get to know each other before we set up a visit.

entries.land_description: woods, meadow, stream in a land trust, 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, electricity/plumbing, camping and indoor space
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors, new members, all women of all colours and persuasions, girl and boy children
entries.notes: We are a new wom'ns community/retreat center, 35 miles north of Baltimore. We have/are: 4 lesbians with a feminist perspective, support for political involvement, strong ties with Baltimore wom'ns community, 35 acres of woods, meadow, stream in a land trust, 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, electricity/plumbing, camping and indoor space. We are developing the retreat center (facilities for up to 50) as a business to support the place and members. Local jobs are possible with wom'n landscaping company, wom'ns printing shop. Long and short term commitment. It's a wonderful place and we want to share it!

entries.community_name: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET
entries.street_address: c/o Nan and Ruth, PO Box 63
entries.land_description: housing & permanent structures, electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, a male dog (does not get along with other male dogs)
entries.welcomed_groups: non-lesbian wimmin, girl & boy children (parental supervision a must), males, medium to small dogs (females only, please)
entries.notes: (Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.) We own 20 acres on which we built a passive solar shell this summer with the help of friends. We have to work away from the land at this point, but one of us is trying to find local work to be able to be more in touch with the land (small-scale farming and a few farm animals are a short-range goal). We are musicians & especially welcome non-competitive musicians and singers. Bring food to share. No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers. wimmin living (full time) and working (part time) on the land.

entries.land_description: hilly southeastern Ohio. We have a house with electricity and a barn and another house under construction. We have dogs, cats, goats, gardens, woods, pond, camping space, farmland
entries.notes: wimmin living and working on and off the land. We welcome wimmin and children to stay up to a week for help with food and work exchange (house remodeling - house building - daily survival chores).

entries.land_description: house/permanent structures, electricity, well, camping space, organic garden, sauna, 2 dogs, cat, woods
entries.notes: (near Virginia). Country living with privacy for womyn. Located in Northern Minnesota, ten miles from town - access to a small lake. Dogs if restrained. Visits require work exchange and/or cash.
We want to establish contact with janes-of-all trades and travelin wimmin: join our efforts to establish campsites, housing, and a cooperative
